g.text: Q7 - Emergency Ad Hoc Network / AODV-Style Route Discovery
Ambulance -> Hospital: Ambulance -> Rescue-1 -> Gateway -> Hospital
Police -> Hospital: Police -> Rescue-2 -> Gateway -> Hospital
[Link failure test] Gateway <-> Rescue-1 link fails
Ambulance after failure: Ambulance -> Police -> Rescue-2 -> Gateway -> Hospital
Result: alternate path selected when one path is unavailable.
Illustrative graph simulation, not packet-level ns-3/OMNeT++.
